run.name: 14-neo-brutalist-sticker
run.finalText:
I'm making a last fit adjustment: shrinking the "-40%" text so it sits inside the starburst. Then I'll check the frame.
The SUMMER SALE -40% post is built on the Main comp (1080×1080, 5s). I checked it in preview frames and a screenshot at 3.5s, but I haven't exported a video.

- **Look:** acid yellow background, with cobalt, hot pink and white flat fills. Everything has an 8px black outline and a black copy offset 12px down-right as its hard shadow. Every piece is tilted a few degrees.
- **Layers:** each element is a group, with its shadow, face and text inside it.
  - **Card:** the big cobalt card with "SUMMER" in yellow.
  - **SaleBar:** the white "SALE" slab.
  - **EndsSticker:** the pink "ENDS SUNDAY" pill. It wasn't in your brief; I added it, along with the next one.
  - **ShipSticker:** the cobalt "FREE SHIPPING" sticker.
  - **Starburst:** the pink starburst with "-40%".
- **Timing:** the stickers slap on one after another, each scaling up from 0 with an overshoot while its rotation snaps to its final tilt. The starburst is last, at 2.3–2.9s, spinning almost a full turn as it lands. After 3.2s it pulses gently.
- **Last tweak:** I shrank the "-40%" text so it fits inside the starburst. I didn't re-check the frame after that change; the screenshot above was taken just after it, so it may not show it.

I can make the slaps snappier, add a hard camera-shake hit when the burst lands, or add a yellow-to-pink background flash.
